description.en: Cline desktop AI coding assistant: WorkOS OAuth device login, token refresh, and model discovery over the Cline catalog (free tier, Cline Pass, Cline Cloud) plus the OpenRouter passthrough list — free models are marked free in their names. Quota polling reports the balance, the Cline Pass usage windows and the account's membership tier.
description.zh: Cline 桌面端 AI 编程助手：WorkOS OAuth 设备码登录、令牌自动续期；模型发现覆盖 Cline 自有目录（免费额度 / Cline Pass / Cline Cloud）与 OpenRouter 直通列表，免费模型在名称里标注「(免费)」。配额查询报告余额、Cline Pass 额度窗口与账号会员等级。

description.en: Log in with your Cline account via WorkOS device authentication, or enter an official API Key directly.
description.zh: 通过 WorkOS 设备代码授权登录你的 Cline 账号，或直接填写官方 API Key。

help_text.en: Cline official API Key from app.cline.bot -> Settings -> API Keys. Leave blank when using browser sign-in.
help_text.zh: Cline 官方 API Key（从 app.cline.bot -> Settings -> API Keys 获取）。使用浏览器登录时可留空。

help_text.en: When set to DeepSeek, requests to non-free DeepSeek models inject providerOptions to force DeepSeek's official upstream.
help_text.zh: 开启后，对非免费的 DeepSeek 模型自动注入 providerOptions，强制 Cline 网关走 DeepSeek 官方通道。

label.zh: DeepSeek 系列强制走官方上游
